feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
entry.summary: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation, as the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

entry.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
entry.summary: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

entry.title: What's next for Democrats after the midterms. And, a look at the outstanding races
entry.summary: Democrats have regained control of Congress. They have a long list of investigations into Trump planned. And, not all races have been called. Here's a look at how they could affect the Dems' majority.

entry.title: Three ways Democrats could reshape U.S. foreign policy after the midterms
entry.summary: On Morning Edition, Pulitzer Prize-winning historian Anne Applebaum breaks down what a Democratic Congress could change about Trump's foreign policy and what remains beyond its power.

entry.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
entry.summary: The American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief.

entry.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong is sentenced to 10 more years in prison
entry.summary: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.

entry.title: Abdul El-Sayed welcomes Trump's plan to cut Israel aid, calls for end to arms sales
entry.summary: Michigan's first Muslim senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed, discusses his historic victory, an unlikely agreement with Trump on Israel military aid and the political divisions that remain.

entry.title: The world is reacting to the Democrats' sweeping midterm elections victory
entry.summary: From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats' big win as foreign powers weigh how a flipped Congress will affect international relations.

entry.title: Democrats seize full control of Congress. And, which candidates made history last night
entry.summary: Democrats have won the House and the Senate, taking full control of Congress for the first time since 2023. And history was made in several states. Here's what happened last night.

entry.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
entry.summary: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.
